newsitem.title: POLAND: BPH $100 mln convertible eurobond in March.
newsitem.headline: BPH $100 mln convertible eurobond in March.

text.p: Polish Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy SA (BPH) plans its $100-million convertible eurobond issue in March, the president of the bank said on Wednesday.
Henryka Pieronkiewicz told a news conference that by the end of February the agent of issue, CS First Boston, would finish preparing an information memorandum on the issue.
"As far as the (convertible) bond issue is concerned, we hope, that we will make it by the end of March...By the end of February there should be an information memorandum," she said.
In January the bank's shareholders approved the ex-rights issue of 100,000 five-year convertible bonds of par value at $1,000, exchangeable for up to 1,994,000 shares.
